source_text.body:
Connect tracking data into customer journeys for SEO
A commenter says agents help connect disparate tracking data and turn parts of it into followable journeys for SEO work.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The commenter used agents to merge tracking data from different channels and reconstruct parts of a customer journey people could actually follow. The agent’s job was mainly identity matching across channel switches; the person still had to judge the analysis because they said it was not accurate or detailed enough on its own.
How it went
It was useful for stitching together journeys when users bounced between channels. The stated limitation was analysis quality: it still performed poorly on accuracy and detail, and no metrics were given.
Worth knowing
The main catch is that this setup helped with matching identities across channels, not with reliable deep analysis, so human review was still necessary.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
I'll paste tracking data from [analytics tool, CRM, ad platform] for [site]. Combine them into [number] typical customer journeys showing the steps from first visit to [conversion], and point out which content or keywords start the best journeys. End with a short list of SEO actions based on those journeys, and tell me where the data is too thin to trust.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/Agentic_SEO/comments/1vma1jg/seo_task_that_you_think_ai_agents_are_genuinely_good_at
